name: Seek First
overview: Scripture calls believers to prioritize seeking God and His kingdom above all else, promising that when we pursue Him with our whole heart, we will find Him and receive all necessary provisions. Jesus teaches that instead of worrying about daily needs, we should seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, trusting that all other things will be added unto us. This pursuit safeguards our souls from the emptiness of worldly gain and invites us to bring our concerns to God through prayer and thanksgiving, resting in His faithful provision.
